statement_en: If the sequence $x_n$ is nonnegative, then $$\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n^2=\left(\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n\right)^2.$$ Likewise for the limit inferior, $$\liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n^2=\left(\liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n\right)^2.$$
final_code:
import Mathlib

theorem nonnegative_sq_limsup_liminf
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ x n) :
    sInf (Set.range (fun N : ℕ => sSup (Set.range (fun n : ℕ => (x (n + N)) ^ 2)))) =
      (sInf (Set.range (fun N : ℕ => sSup (Set.range (fun n : ℕ => x (n + N)))))) ^ 2
    ∧
    sSup (Set.range (fun N : ℕ => sInf (Set.range (fun n : ℕ => (x (n + N)) ^ 2)))) =
      (sSup (Set.range (fun N : ℕ => sInf (Set.range (fun n : ℕ => x (n + N)))))) ^ 2 := by
  sorry
